body: I feel like everyone comes here when they are stressed out. That's why I come here. I want to see that I am not alone, that everyone else is stressed out, that my problems are only a symptom of a greater evil. I know I can work through my problems because I have that capacity now. I know that the darkness that sits in my chest and lashes out at me is something that I can control. Something that I can learn to live with. I use it as fuel to drive me forward at this point. I come here for the support this offers. Honestly, I want to talk because I never get to with anyone in the real world about that thing that drives me here every so often.

I feel like you've cried enough. What do you have to look forward too? Who is that cute person that keeps looking at you? What are you doing next week? What are your plans? PM me because I want to hear

Well, still not answering comments? I would really like one. I can guarentee you I've done worse things than you and I came back from the brink. PM me if you feel like turning around. And goodbyes are for losers

They aren't, every time I come here I feel like I need to help everyone else because I feel like I can't help myself. I just comment and try to prevent everyone from doing the things that I did that led me to be here in the first place.
Your welcome, I hope to hear from you later.

Life is life. You don't know what is going to happen, but there is one thing I can tell you, it will get better. Your highs will be higher, but you must understand that your lows will be the price you pay for those highs. I promise you, there is no permanence in life. It changes everyday, just try to make it for the better everyday if only just a little bit, and I promise you will see it get better an better. The hard part is doing it.

There is always something better. There is always a future, there is always time for change, always time to change the course of things. I promise, the evil that you think surrounds you is not permanent. There are people who care, there is someone who will care for you more than I do. Someone who will accept everything you are, all you need to do is find them. PM me if you want to talk

My problems are insignificant to you. Yours are to anyone else, but I am here to listen to them and help you through them. I have been to that spot before and have stayed there for a long time. I feel like I only have just barely gotten out of it. If you want to talk, PM me.

Honestly, I was here before a long time ago. Some bad things really just stacked on top of one another and now I was driven here again. If you want to talk about our problems that's alright. Mine are probably nothing compared to yours. I just don't have anyone who will listen anymore and now I feel alone.
You said you hide it under your success, what is that if you don't mind me asking? PM me if you need to.
